title: Natural vs. Man-made
ques: Look at these two things: a **Tree** and a **Car**. Which one is natural, and which one is man-made? Explain the difference.

answer.content: The **Tree** is natural because it grows in nature and is not built by people. The **Car** is man-made because it was built in a factory by people.

explanation: This exercises the ability to classify objects into natural and artificial categories.

title: Keeping Surroundings Clean
ques: If you finish eating a packet of chips in the park, what is the right thing to do with the empty wrapper?

answer.content: The right thing to do is to throw the empty wrapper into a dustbin. We should never throw garbage on the ground, so we can keep our surroundings clean and beautiful.

explanation: This promotes civic sense and environmental responsibility.

title: Home vs. School Environment
ques: Name one room that you have in your house but do not have at your school.

answer.content: Example answer: A bedroom or a kitchen. (Schools usually have classrooms and cafeterias instead).

explanation: This helps children differentiate between the different types of environments they interact with daily.
